rows.propositionOrDisposition: Clustering causes cooperation prevalence

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Betweenness causes later information access

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Eigenvector centrality is social influence

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Centrality to exposure to behavior is a demonstrated pathway

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Cultural homophily causes assortativity

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Illness causes less network bridging

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Seating proximity causes closure rate

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Algorithmic filtering causes network segregation
rows.rationale: Existing REL-TEC-050 review, not a duplicate edge; feed/exposure/follow mixing not same construct.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Closeness causes resource control
rows.rationale: Flow and resource access mechanism needs matching path assumptions and exact resource-control construct.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Component fragmentation changes directly through node deletion
rows.rationale: RDS is recalculated; node/boundary operation lacks a complete Driver target; blocked derivation metadata preserved.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: A static position TRANSITIONS_TO later behavior
rows.rationale: Different constructs are not qualified states of one entity; dynamic causality needs independent evidence.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Closure causes local clustering purely by completing triangles
rows.rationale: Triangle-count contribution to snapshot statistic is derivation, not an extra propagated effect; interval and denominator differ.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Observed storm proves all later tie effects
rows.rationale: Occurrence verification cannot identify every consequence; quasi-experimental comparison still has assumptions.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: High-degree seeding is universally best
rows.rationale: Outcome-specific trial and review do not support universal superiority or recommendation.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Social isolation equals zero degree
rows.rationale: Observed isolate in chosen boundary is not perceived isolation/belonging; ties outside sample may exist.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Development raises triadic closure
rows.rationale: Observed preschool network emergence is not isolated biological maturation; no canonical developmental Driver substituted.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Betweenness and degree association is construction-free
rows.rationale: Shared network and graph size require conditional operationalizations and a scoped empirical estimate.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: Network metrics realize the latent real network without error
rows.rationale: Representation, estimator and real network are distinct; missing ties and boundaries matter.

rows.propositionOrDisposition: A network is compositionally constituted by its centrality scores
rows.rationale: Scores do not uniquely specify ties; no composition edge from a metric to real network.
